content_units: You already have a credible entry route into HR because your background covers several core people-operations tasks:   onboarding, training, scheduling, employee issues, payroll coordination, and team supervision  . With   6 hours per week for 4 months   and a target of   £28,000+ in Manchester  , the most realistic path is into   HR Coordinator / HR Administrator / People Operations Coordinator / Recruitment Coordinator   roles, with   HR Advisor   as a stretch target if you can evidence policy handling and employee relations exposure.
Your story is not “retail to HR from scratch”; it is   people management and operations experience being reframed into HR language  .
Best-Fit HR Roles to Target First
Role   Typical fit for you   Likely salary range in Manchester   Why it matches
HR Coordinator   Strong   £28,000-£33,000   Best bridge role; combines admin, onboarding, systems, and employee support
HR Administrator   Strong   £25,000-£30,000   Easiest entry, but some roles may fall below your salary floor
People Coordinator / People Operations Coordinator   Strong   £28,000-£34,000   Good fit if company uses modern “People” titles instead of HR
Recruitment Coordinator / Talent Coordinator   Medium-Strong   £27,000-£32,000   Good if you can show hiring support, interviewing, rota planning, and candidate handling
HR Assistant   Medium   £25,000-£29,000   Viable, but some postings may be too junior on pay
Junior HR Advisor   Stretch   £30,000-£36,000   Possible only if you build confidence in policies, ER basics, and HR systems
3.   HR Administrator   at larger employers with better salary bands
5.   Junior HR Advisor   as a selective stretch application
Transferable Strengths to Put Front and Centre
Option 1:   Employee lifecycle support     You already support people from hiring through training and day-to-day issues   Strongest HR bridge
- Translate your experience into HR wording:
- “Supported onboarding and induction for new starters”
- “Handled first-line employee queries and issue resolution”
- “Coordinated shift planning in line with staffing needs and absence cover”
- “Delivered training and coached team members on policy and process”
Option 2:   People problem-solving     Conflict resolution and team supervision map directly to employee relations fundamentals   High-value differentiator
Option 3:   Operational accuracy and confidentiality     Payroll coordination, records, and scheduling show trust and process discipline   Essential for HR admin roles
Option 4:   Training and line support     Retail leadership often involves coaching, induction, and performance support   Useful for People Coordinator and HR Advisor-track roles
Gaps to Close Before Applying Hard
-   Stronger HR framing on your CV
- your current experience likely reads as operations-heavy rather than people-operations-heavy
- even a short recognised course helps signal commitment
Worth doing, but not mandatory in 4 months

This helps, but it is   not strictly required   to get interviews for coordinator/admin roles if your experience is reframed well. If budget allows, it strengthens credibility; if not, short HR courses plus a strong CV can still work.

You have about   96 hours total   available over 4 months at 6 hours a week. That is enough to build a solid transition if you focus on   job targeting, CV language, HR basics, and interview stories  .
Weeks 1-4   Reposition your experience   Rewrite CV in HR language; update LinkedIn; collect 6-8 achievement examples; review 20 Manchester HR job ads   HR-targeted CV + target title list
Weeks 5-8   Build HR knowledge   Study core UK HR topics; complete 1 short HR course; learn right-to-work, onboarding, absence, disciplinaries basics   Certificate + interview notes

Weeks 9-12   Build proof and start applying   Tailor CV to coordinator/admin roles; create STAR examples; practice spreadsheet and HRIS language; apply to 5-8 roles weekly   Active applications + polished answers

Weeks 13-16   Interview and refine   Mock interviews; improve weak areas from feedback; expand to selected Junior HR Advisor roles; network with local recruiters   Interview-ready profile + wider pipeline
-   2 hours  : CV, LinkedIn, and tailoring applications
-   1 hour  : job market review and recruiter outreach
What Your CV Should Sound Like
Reframe your current work into HR-ready bullets
- Supported   onboarding and induction   for new team members, helping new starters become productive quickly.
- Managed   rotas, attendance, and staffing coverage  , ensuring operational needs were met while responding to absence issues.
- Acted as first point of contact for   employee queries, conduct concerns, and workplace conflicts  , resolving issues professionally and escalating where needed.
- Coordinated   payroll inputs   and checked time-related records for accuracy before submission deadlines.
- Delivered   training and coaching   for new and existing employees, improving consistency and service standards.
- Maintained confidential employee information and handled sensitive matters with discretion.

“People-focused operations supervisor with 6 years’ experience in team leadership, onboarding, training, employee issue handling, scheduling and payroll coordination. Seeking to transition into HR/People roles in Manchester, bringing strong employee support, administration, and process management skills.”
- larger retailers with central HR teams
- professional services firms with coordinator roles
- public and quasi-public employers where salary bands are transparent
-   Very realistic  : £28,000-£31,000 in Coordinator / People Coordinator roles
-   Possible but less consistent  : HR Administrator at £28,000+
-   Stretch but achievable  : £30,000+ Junior HR Advisor after strong preparation
-   CIPD career guidance and HR profession info
-   National Careers Service role profiles and CV support
-   GOV.UK employer basics for practical HR process understanding
